facts: 500 to 650 m up in the Central Valley, between the Andes and the Coastal Range
worth_knowing: Pedro de Valdivia founded it on 12 February 1541 as Santiago del Nuevo Extremo, laying out a grid around the Plaza Mayor, now the Plaza de Armas.
